limitations: Terminal events include undeveloped functional events, not fully resolved basic component failures.
Shared R-01 is a single reused functional event per incident; not independent across branches.
No occurrence probabilities or independence assumptions.
A combination in the model is not evidence all components occurred simultaneously in a recorded trial.
event_evaluation_scope: Every event is evaluated within the SAME observation interval e. No cross-trial AND combinations. R-01(e) is shared only inside that interval.
